lines.lyric: Like a bulldozer, like a tank, like a soldier
lines.lyric_hangul: Like a bulldozer Like a tank Like a soldier
lines.lyric_translation: Like a bulldozer, Like a tank, Like a soldier
I’m going to destroy your heart

lines.lyric: Mojori da ppaeseul kkeoya neoye sarangeul
lines.lyric_hangul: 모조리 다 뺏을 거야 너의 사랑을
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going to take all your love away
No one could make my heart run
But it just did
The moment you appeared
My heart started running
One-four time, one-eight time*
It’s running faster
A triplet, a triplet**
What should I do? What should I do?
It’s a brand new feeling

lines.lyric: Like a bulldozer, like a tank, like a soldier
lines.lyric_hangul: Like a bulldozer Like a tank Like a soldier
lines.lyric_translation: Like a bulldozer, Like a tank, Like a soldier
I’m going to destroy your heart

lines.lyric: Mojori da ppaeseul kkeoya neoye sarangeul
lines.lyric_hangul: 모조리 다 뺏을 거야 너의 사랑을
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going to take all your love away

lines.lyric: Niga mame deureo jeolttae notchil su eopseo
lines.lyric_translation: I like you, I won’t ever miss this chance
It’s time to show my hidden charms
I had been saving them for a day like this
How should I start?
A wink, a gesture, a hand sign, no, no
Confidently, being myself
I’ll just get close and talk to you
It’s getting closer, it’s coming up
It’s the moment I dreamed about
I’m ready. No, I’m not ready
What should I do? What should I do? I don’t have the confidence
No, I have confidence

lines.lyric: Like a bulldozer, like a tank, like a soldier
lines.lyric_hangul: Like a bulldozer Like a tank Like a soldier
lines.lyric_translation: Like a bulldozer, Like a tank, Like a soldier
I’m going to destroy your heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 모조리 다 뺏을 거야 너의 사랑을
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going to take all your love away

lines.lyric: Niga mame deureo jeolttae notchil su eopseo
lines.lyric_translation: I like you, I won’t ever miss this chance
It’s time to show my hidden charms
I had been saving them for a day like this
Continuously thumping
My heart is running but my feet feel like floating
I walk in the sky towards you, zoom zoom

lines.lyric: Gakkai galsurok I feel like I’m on the moon
lines.lyric_hangul: 가까이 갈수록 I feel like I'm on the moon
lines.lyric_translation: As I get closer, I feel like I am on the moon

lines.lyric: Like a bulldozer, like a tank, like a soldier
lines.lyric_hangul: Like a bulldozer Like a tank Like a soldier
lines.lyric_translation: Like a bulldozer, Like a tank, Like a soldier
Confidently and gallantly I’ll get closer
I hesitate… I won’t regret it

lines.lyric: Niga mame deureo jeolttae notchil su eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 맘에 들어 절대 놓칠 수 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I like you, I won’t ever miss this chance

lines.lyric: Neoreul weonhae neoneun eottae mureobol kkeoya
lines.lyric_hangul: 너를 원해 너는 어때 물어볼 거야
lines.lyric_translation: I want you, I will ask you how you feel
I won’t wait like a fool
